name: edytlab
description: Describe it. Get pro-grade audio edits.

paragraphs: A Tauri 2 desktop audio editor where producers, podcasters, and DJs do real audio editing by chatting with an AI agent. Drop two MP3s, ask for a mashup, get a rendered WAV. Drop stems, refine the mix through conversation with audible A/B at every turn.
Local-first, multi-provider, pure-Rust DSP. Builds for macOS (universal), Windows and Linux.
features: Conversational multi-track production. Say "match Neon Rush to Midnight Drive's tempo, start it 8 bars before Midnight Drive ends, crossfade with a low-pass on the outgoing track, then master to −14 LUFS and export a…

Pure-Rust DSP. Decode (symphonia), resampling (rubato), and effects written in-house in crates/audio-dsp — a crate with deliberately zero dependencies. DSP quality is non-negotiable and there is no Python in the hot…
Local-first. Audio never leaves your machine unless you export. The agent talks to the LLM you pick — a hosted one, or a local model through Ollama; the audio engine runs entirely in-process.

Multi-provider LLMs out of the box. Anthropic, OpenRouter, OpenAI, Groq, Gemini and Ollama — each hosted provider with its own key in the OS keychain (Ollama needs none), switchable from the Settings panel without…
Branchable session graph. Every state is a node in a DAG. Fork, name, compare, revert — A/B is first-class, not an undo stack. The Graph view draws the DAG next to the timeline.

whatItDoes.text: A Tauri 2 desktop audio editor where producers, podcasters, and DJs do real audio editing by chatting with an AI agent. Drop two MP3s, ask for a mashup, get a rendered WAV. Drop stems, refine the mix through conversation with audible A/B at every turn.

requirements.text: Each hosted provider has its own API key slot in the OS keychain (Ollama needs no key), and you can switch the active provider from the gear icon in the app header without restarting.
